_note: Bench measurements of the printed robot (grams, millimetres). Calibration takes masses from here, not from CAD.

body_tpu_mass_g._note: TPU body ALONE (confirmed by Om 25 Oct); effective density 30.4 / 26.02 = 1.17 g/cm3 vs 1.21 nominal (-3.5 %), so expect the print a few % softer than E = 56 MPa; weigh all four bodies

joint_mass_g._note: to weigh: one coupler + dowel + 3 plugs; enters the twin as a point mass at each joint

homing_repeatability_mm._note: to measure: home all tendons 5 times, log the zero spread (target < 0.05 mm)

stand_up_test.2026-10-25: 4 modules do NOT stand with slack tendons; stand only with a good amount of pretension
stand_up_test._note: pretension must be a known servo command (common pull on every tendon after homing), not set by hand; record the smallest pretension at which the stack stands
